### Checklist conclusions

- **Shape.**

- **Rule text, line by line.**
  - The p0 row now says ⛔ 不豁免重叠检查.
  - `domain:*` no longer decides 热文件串行. That matches #34512 (SKILL.md L162 and objectstack.md L15).

  - The seat-post `热文件串行队` section keeps its name and is redefined as the exit-1 queue. The region-level declaration is kept.
  - The claim template keeps the same-package predecessor and moves same-file to the check.
  - Nothing restates the exit table beyond "exit 1 queues behind the listed PR".
- **The seat's question: did dropping `pm:dispatched` from the `ui/**` line (`execution-duties.md` L45) change what is intersected?** No.
  - The line still says 在飞求交, the in-flight intersection.
  - `SKILL.md` L182, unchanged, defines the in-flight check as reading the declared file surface on the claim comments of `pm:dispatched` cards.
  - So the set read is still the dispatched `domain:ui` claims. The qualifier was a restatement.
  - What did change is the action on a hit: 照重叠检查排队或让行, instead of 串行或让行. A claim-only `ui` card has no PR head for the tool to merge. The check before every push covers that gap once its PR exists.
- **Line rules at head.**
  - `check-skill-line-ratchet` is green on every touched file: SKILL.md 329/329, widest table row 341/341; execution-duties 190/190; seat-lifecycle 100/100; seat-post-protocol 88/88; lanes/objectstack 35/35. No ceiling or pin moved.

  - `check-skill-id-lint` reads `118 file(s) clean`.
- **Gates.**
  - Check-runs on this head: 52 runs, 24 `success`, 28 `skipped`, 0 failure, 0 pending.
  - `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` aggregate, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Check Changeset` are all `success`.
  - I take the check-runs as the gate record.

### Accepted deviations / observations

- O1 (for L2 ④): the pointers send the classic PM loop and the seat post to a rule whose home is under `area-lease.md` 〈区内规则〉. When #34512 landed, its body said that rule "binds area-lease mode only". This PR widens its reach to every mode. That is what the card asks ("one answer for same-file work"), and it answers the out-of-scope finding in contract review 6933258205 ③. No line in `area-lease.md` says the rule applies outside area mode, so a reader takes the scope from the pointers.
- O2 (for L2 ④): `lanes/server.md` L58 keeps 同文件卡跨轮硬串行 under a shared engine or datasource seam. The trigger is semantic, so keeping it is defensible. The wording still makes the textual condition (same file) its subject, though, and that condition is now the overlap check's to answer. A seam rule could name the seam's cards rather than the same file.
- O3: the section name `热文件串行队` and the label `fold-or-serial` are kept, so live seat posts stay valid. The body offers renames as the seat's call. That is accepted.

**Yes, and still open.** `.claude/**` is governed rules text, and the pm-dispatch root is always at contract tier, so it owes `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. At the time of reading, this head carries only a claim: `l2-review#4`, comment 6935128021, head `bef42322…`. There is no PASS yet.

- No published surface, schema, script or gate changes: five skill-text files only. `area-lease.md` line 37 stays the rule's one home and is not edited. Right.
- Accept-set moves, each read against `area-lease.md` line 37 and the `overlap-check.mjs` header ("two seats may share a file, and only a real textual conflict queues one behind the other"):

The cut of "的 `pm:dispatched`" at line 45 moves nothing: `SKILL.md` 183 still defines the in-flight check as reading `pm:dispatched` claims.

Newly allowed: opening the second card's thread in parallel. Right: this is the rule #34512 landed, and line 49 still holds a card behind a real `Blocked-by:`.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md` 31 and `seat-post-protocol.md` 19: the seat post's hot-file queue section is redefined as the exit-1 queue list. Right in direction; too narrow as worded, see S3.
- Done-when ("the old default leaves only the pointer lines"): not fully met on this head. Two sentences outside the PR's own grep pattern still state the old answer, see S1 and S2. The semantic-coupling lines the PR keeps (`SKILL.md` 186, `lanes/server.md` 56 and 58, `landing-operations.md` 104, `platform-readings.md` 80) are a different rule (merge-tree cannot see them) and are right to keep.
- Line budget (the ratchet gate ran green in CI on this head): `SKILL.md` 329 lines against ceiling 329, widest table row 341 bytes against pin 341 (line 118, untouched; the p0 row is 264 bytes); `execution-duties.md` 190/190; `seat-lifecycle.md` 100/100; `seat-post-protocol.md` 88/88 (+1 line); `lanes/objectstack.md` 35/35. Longest added prose line 119 bytes against the 120-byte cap. No ceiling or pin moved.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` is not published and no package changes. `Check Changeset` concluded success.
- Clause-②: no — right. No published accept set widens or narrows; the moves in ① are fleet-process rules for seats.

### ③ Boundary flags

- open_questions 1 (contract review owed on this head): answered by this record.
- open_questions 2 (rename the `热文件串行队` section and the `fold-or-serial` label): option A, keep both names. A rename changes no behaviour and makes every live seat post stale. The definition, not the name, is what S3 asks to correct.

- SQL push-down: not applicable. No code, no query, no id materialisation in the diff.
- No dev flag is left unanswered. Nothing to escalate to the maintainer.

### ④ Design judgment

Every changed sentence was read against `area-lease.md` line 37 and the `overlap-check.mjs` header. The thirteen edits each agree with the rule. The findings are about what the edits leave beside them.

- S1 (should-fix) — `SKILL.md` 128, the `area:*` row, still reads "同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交": two same-axis cards whose file surfaces intersect run one at a time. This PR's own `execution-duties.md` 26 now says same-area cards queue by the overlap check, and line 35 says the same for a region-level claim. A seat reading row 128 serialises the pair; a seat reading line 26 runs both and queues only on exit 1. That is the two-answer defect the card exists to remove, in a `hits` file, and the PR's grep pattern (串行, 热文件, 同文件) cannot match it. The row is 338 bytes against the 341-byte pin, so the fix must be paid inside the row.
- S2 (should-fix) — `references/project-forms.md` 45 still reads "认领文件面相交或须先落 `Notify: serial`", and the ring's template is `#a behind #b`. Mere intersection of claimed surfaces therefore still produces a "behind" order between seats, while `lanes/objectstack.md` 28 says only a real overlap queues and rings. The PR body keeps this line as "a heads-up"; the template's wording is an order, not a heads-up. The trigger should be the exit-1 case (or "must land first"), in prose. The English `when` text of the same key in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` ("claimed file surfaces overlap") is outside this card's surface and belongs to a follow-up card if it needs to move.
- S3 (should-fix) — `seat-lifecycle.md` 31 ("只列 … exit 1 排队的卡") and `seat-post-protocol.md` 19 ("= … exit 1 的排队清单") make the section exclusive to exit-1 cards. The same PR keeps live serial rules that are not exit-1 cases: `lanes/server.md` 56 (the version-family "热文件面串行") and 58, and the generated-artifact relay. Those chains lose their place in the seat post, and with it in the handover (`seat-post-protocol.md` 53 hands the queue over). The same wording leaves `execution-duties.md` 33 pointing at a "串行队条目" as the place of a fold answer that, when the check is clean, has no entry to live in. The card asks to align the same-file default, not to drop the other serial chains from the post. The definition should admit both: exit-1 cards and the serial chains a lane charter still names.
- N1 (nit) — "exit 1" is spelled at three new lines (`execution-duties.md` 33, `seat-lifecycle.md` 31, `seat-post-protocol.md` 19). The card asks for pointers that do not restate the rule; one arm of the exit table is restated three times and goes stale together if `area-lease.md` changes it. Accepted deviation or follow-up.
- N2 (nit) — for a p0, the direction on exit 1 is the reverse of `area-lease.md` line 37: `execution-duties.md` 24 pauses the lower-grade dev instead of queueing the p0 behind its PR, while `SKILL.md` 127 says the p0 is not exempt from the check. Neither line names the other. The same pair existed before this PR in the old wording; a follow-up card may add the cross-reference in the rule's home.
- N3 (nit) — `execution-duties.md` 23 ("同批独立按文件面不相交判") is untouched and can be read as requiring disjoint files inside one batch. Its point is the lock-width cap, not queueing; follow-up at most.

No must-fix. S1, S2 and S3 are open on this head and each earns a delta review of its fix.
